leadership.name: Poonam Kumari
leadership.bio: Poonam leads VSJ AI Labs with a vision to build compliance-first AI and enterprise technology that helps organizations modernize operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation. She owns business strategy, client success, partnerships, and organizational growth — ensuring every solution aligns with industry standards and customer outcomes.

leadership.name: Ashish Kumar Satyam
leadership.bio: Ashish is a Solution Architect and full-stack engineering leader with 9+ years delivering enterprise-scale platforms across BFSI, Insurance, FinTech, Healthcare, and SaaS. He specializes in secure, cloud-native systems on React, Next.js, React Native, Java Spring Boot, AWS, and microservices. At VSJ AI Labs he owns technology strategy, engineering excellence, cloud modernization, and AI-driven product innovation.

leadership.name: Yogesh Kumar Upadhyay
leadership.bio: Yogesh brings 11+ years of hands-on engineering across Banking and Insurance — including microservices for Max Life Insurance policy management at Infosys, partner-bank integrations with Axis and Yes Bank, and cloud-native platforms at Hexaware. At VSJ AI Labs he owns delivery governance, program execution, and quality assurance across client engagements — ensuring engineering rigor, on-time releases, and tight collaboration between business and technology teams.
